title: Count Commas in Range II
summary: Given an integer n, calculate the total number of commas used in the standard number formatting of all integers from 1 to n, where commas are placed after every three digits from the right, and no commas are used in numbers with fewer than four digits.
statement: Given an integer n, calculate the total number of commas used in the standard number formatting of all integers from 1 to n, where commas are placed after every three digits from the right, and no commas are used in numbers with fewer than four digits.
constraints: Format every integer from one through n with a comma after each group of three digits from the right.
Return the total number of comma characters used.
hints: Every number at least 1,000 contributes its first comma, every number at least 1,000,000 contributes another, and so on.
Count how many values reach each power-of-1000 threshold.
For threshold t<=n, add n-t+1 and multiply t by 1000.
Summing threshold contributions counts each formatted comma exactly once.
editorial: Summing threshold contributions counts each formatted comma exactly once.

tests.explanation: Values 1000, 1001, and 1002 each use one comma, totaling three.
Every value from 1000 contributes one comma and 1,000,000 contributes a second comma.
